items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) Could Be 23% Undervalued As Buybacks Come Into Focus
items.summary: Capital shift under Greg Abel puts Berkshire Hathaway buybacks in focus Greg Abel has reshaped capital use at Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B), with the conglomerate turning into a net seller of equities in the third quarter of 2026 while stepping up repurchases. The business bought back US$9.6b of its own shares in the quarter, taking year to date repurchases above US$14b and putting Berkshire Hathaway's capital allocation and valuation squarely on investors' radar. items.title: Warren Buffett's Successor, Greg Abel, Overhauled Berkshire's Portfolio for a 3rd Straight Quarter, Reducing 6 Stocks and Piling Into a Hot Tech IPO
items.summary: This isn’t your grandparents’ Berkshire Hathaway any longer.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Doubles Down on U.S. Housing
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway nearly doubled its stake in home builder Lennar, adding to its bet on the U.S. housing industry, while confirming its position in Italian web-services firm Bending Spoons.

items.title: Berkshire trims Bank of America, Capital One stakes, adds to Delta investment
items.summary: Investment.com -- Berkshire Hathaway reshuffled its equity portfolio in the third quarter, cutting its exposure to Bank of America and Capital One while increasing its investment in Delta Air Lines and building a new position in Italian technology company Bending Spoons, a regulatory filing showed on Monday.

items.title: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Just Revealed a New $689 Million Stock. The Company’s IPO Was Less Than Five Months Ago
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's new 13F shows 20,689,655 shares of Bending Spoons, the owner of AOL, Evernote and Vimeo, which priced its initial public offering on June 30.

items.title: Berkshire Boosts Lennar, Starts Bending Spoons, Trims Bank Of America In Q3
